phone.notes: Big rework: Time Stranger stats and damage formula, skills with 11 elements and weaknesses, SPI, skill seals, auto-play of cleared dungeon floors with tickets, nicknames, an Adventures menu, promo codes and more. If something feels unfair or breaks, tell us in #bug-reports. Requires Android 13 or newer.

watch.notes: New exercises: Meditate (30 s still, INT) and Jog (30 s running, SPI), the daily training total is shown, and a fix for steps not counting for wild encounters and the farm.
